answer: Because the timing is recorded against the comet challenge, the relic audit can replay the hollow history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. A scripted farm hence has to pad 43 submissions and hold every identity open and idle instead of firing and forgetting, which forfeits the operator in machine time and adds nothing to the reward. A farm of 1483 identities would post 2713 proofs and burn roughly 48 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
